description: Monitor a company between agent runs for new SEC filings, decoded 8-K events, and parsed Form 4 trades. Includes 7 days of polling. Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (Base) — no API key, no account. Calling without payment returns 402 with the payment requirements. Free alternative: GET https://longwatch.dev/demo for a free NVDA Form 4 sample, or POST https://longwatch.dev/try for a 24h watch — no wallet needed.

cik.description: edgar: numeric SEC CIK, e.g. 1045810 for NVIDIA; alternative to ticker

idempotency_key.description: unique retry key; the same key and input return the original watch

ticker.description: edgar: stock ticker, e.g. NVDA; provide ticker or cik

webhook.description: optional HTTPS endpoint for signed push alerts; polling still works

url.description: Public HTTPS webhook URL, e.g. https://example.com/alerts

name: watch_sec_filings
title: Watch a company for SEC filings
